caption: The drawing features two primary objects: an outlined depiction of a jug or crock, and a detailed, free-floating decorative motif. The jug is shown in a simple blue outline in the upper left quadrant of the paper, with two small handles on each side and the number "3" inscribed near the top. On the front of the jug is a decorative motif rendered in blue, which is repeated in much larger scale in the lower right quadrant of the image, occupying the majority of the page. The motif consists of a swirling, curling vine with circular and oval forms, leaf-like shapes, and dot accents, all painted in blue watercolor or ink. The background is a light tan or beige color, and the larger motif is set against a slightly darker, shadowed area, giving some depth to the design. There are some faint signs of age or wear, such as discoloration and staining, especially along the upper and lower edge of the paper. The artist's signature is present at the bottom left of the image.
title: Jar
